tagline.en: Global MVNO on O2/EE in the UK — £10 top-up covers ~90 days (credit expires at 90)
tagline.zh: 全球性虚商（英国走O2/EE）——充10镑约覆盖90天（余额90天过期）

description.en: Lycamobile is a UK-headquartered global MVNO active in 60 countries; in the UK it runs mainly on O2 and EE networks. Order online and pick eSIM at checkout; after 90 days without a call, message, data use or top-up Lyca sends a warning, and the number is deactivated and reallocated after a further 30-day grace period (minimum top-up £10; credit itself expires 90 days from the top-up date). No long-term contract — cancel or change anytime; voucher top-ups supported.
description.zh: Lycamobile是总部位于英国的全球性虚商，在60个国家开展业务；在英国主要使用O2和EE网络。官网直接下单，结账时可选eSIM；90天内无通话/短信/流量/充值会收到提醒，再经30天宽限仍无使用即停机且号码会被重新分配（最低充值10英镑；充值余额自充值起90天过期）。无长期合约，可随时取消或更改，支持充值卡密充值。

details.en:
Lycamobile is the call-centric global MVNO: its bundles skew toward international minutes rather than China-roaming data, and its keep-alive is top-up based — roughly £10 per 90 days (after 90 days without a call, message, data or top-up Lyca warns you, then deactivates the SIM and reallocates the number after a 30-day grace; top-up credit expires 90 days from the top-up date), clearly worse value than giffgaff's £0.30 SMS or VOXI's £5/180 days. The upside is familiarity and reach: it operates in 60 countries, so the same account logic works for relatives abroad, and voucher-based top-ups (scratch cards) exist where cards aren't an option. eSIM can be selected during bundle purchase on the official site. No contract lock-in.

Trade-offs: mainland-China roaming is not its design centre (the source review does not recommend it for China-roaming cloud residents); network priority as an MVNO sits below host-network subscribers; and bundle-heavy marketing means the cheapest keep-alive path is simply topping up and not buying anything.
details.zh:
Lycamobile 是以国际通话为中心的全球性虚商：套餐结构偏向跨国通话分钟数而非回国流量，保号走充值制——约每 90 天充值 10 英镑（90 天内无通话/短信/流量/充值会收到警告，再经 30 天宽限即停机且号码重新分配；充值余额自充值日起 90 天过期），单次成本明显高于 giffgaff 的 0.3 镑短信路线或 VOXI 的 5 英镑/180 天门槛。

它的优势在规模与触达：业务覆盖约 60 个国家，海外亲属可以沿用同一套账户逻辑使用当地 Lycamobile；没有国际信用卡时还支持充值卡密（刮刮卡）付费，支付灵活性是它相对同行的实在优点。官网购买套餐时可勾选 eSIM，无长期合约锁定，随时可停。

需要清醒的取舍：中国大陆漫游不是它的设计场景，源盘点明确不推荐云居民把它当漫游主力；作为虚商，其流量优先级低于宿主网络（O2/EE）本网用户；营销以套餐捆绑为主，最省钱的保号路径其实是只充值、不买任何套餐。

bestFor.en: Users who mainly call internationally and want a no-contract UK number with voucher top-up options.
bestFor.zh: 以国际通话为主、想要无合约英国号码并支持卡密充值的用户。
